# CohortRecipes

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/OHDSI/CohortRecipes/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/OHDSI/CohortRecipes/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![Codecov test coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/OHDSI/CohortRecipes/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/OHDSI/CohortRecipes)
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of CohortRecipes is to standardise common cohort definitions in OMOP CDM. You can use your own conceptSets or the ones defined in OmopConcepts.

## Installation

You can install the development version of CohortRecipes like so:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ohdsi/CohortRecipes")
```

Or from CRAN:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
install.packages("CohortRecipes")
```
